counterevidence: Few points on one benchmark threshold; list prices; a threshold fixed in 2023 measures commodity capability, not frontier capability. Artificial Analysis gives today's price, not the launch price, so its points for models released before 10 Sep 2026 probably sit low and the halving probably reads slower than it was, and a later price cut on an old model can make it a record after the fact; the two sources run GPQA with different harnesses, each held to its own GPT-4, so the direction of that difference is unknown.

crosswalk.note: Capability growth is the model layer's product; inference price at fixed capability ⇄ price-per-token pass-through; open-weights lag ⇄ open-vs-closed gap.

definition: Halving time of the lowest price per million tokens among models at least as good as GPT-4 on GPQA Diamond, fitted from 2023. Epoch's price-trend series while Epoch covered new models (it stopped in February 2025), then each later model on Artificial Analysis that clears GPT-4's own score there and undercuts every model before it. Derived metric inference_price_halving_days.

evidence.snippet: The rate of decline varies dramatically depending on the performance milestone, ranging from 9x to 900x per year.

status_events.counterevidence_considered: Artificial Analysis's points use current list prices, not launch prices, which probably makes the halving read slower; a later price cut can turn an old model into a record after the fact; the two GPQA harnesses differ in a direction nobody has measured.
status_events.reason: Epoch stopped updating its price chart in February 2025, so the series now continues on Artificial Analysis: each model released after Epoch's coverage ended that clears GPT-4's own GPQA Diamond score there and undercuts every model before it. On twelve points from 2023 to April 2026 the lowest price halves every 122 days (CI 89-192), just outside the fast band (110 days or less) and short of normal (230 days or more), so the status stays emerging; the interval does not reach either band. The Epoch-only fit read 68 days.

status_events.author: evaluate
status_events.reason: Epoch's price-trend series for the GPQA Diamond threshold set by GPT-4-0314: the lowest price per million tokens halves every 68 days (CI 38-317) on six points from 2023 to December 2024, inside the fast band (110 days or less, about 40x a year). Single tier-6 source with six points caps the status at emerging; the series ends in December 2024 and is refreshed when Epoch republishes it. Initial seed.

timing_rationale: Coincident: prices fall the day a cheaper model matches the benchmark, when buyers can switch.
tracker_interpretation: Few points, and the cheapest model at a fixed threshold is rarely the frontier; the METR-hour price series on OpenRouter is the companion reading.
why_it_matters: Price per unit of capability on a benchmark axis, the lab layer's capture proxy; the brief cites about 40x a year at this threshold.
